name: CaptchEtat
description: Provides a CAPTCHA challenge by connecting to the French government CaptchEtat API.
project_description:
This module seamlessly integrates the CaptchEtat API into Drupal, empowering government websites adhering to DSFR standards with enhanced security measures. CaptchEtat, a robust solution available through Piste Gouv , it provides a distorted CAPTCHA string for the user to copy and serves as a pivotal tool in safeguarding online interactions against automated threats. 

 Key Features: 
 
 Effortless Integration: With this module, Drupal administrators can effortlessly integrate CaptchEtat into their websites, bolstering security without extensive technical expertise. 
 Webform Compatibility with [1.0.x]: Designed to seamlessly integrate with the Webform module, this extension enables the inclusion of CaptchEtat challenges within web forms, ensuring reliable protection against spam and unauthorized access. 
 
 Captcha Compatibility with [2.0.x]: Designed to seamlessly integrate CaptchEtat captcha to forms using the Captcha

 points configuration page of the Captcha module.
 
 
 Requirements: 
 To leverage the functionalities of this module, ensure you have both the (Webform module with 1.0.x or Captcha module with 2.0.x) and Drupal core installed. Additionally, obtain a pair of authentication keys from Piste Gouv — a secret key and a client key — to authenticate your integration securely.

 Installation and Configuration: 
 
 Installation: Simply download and enable the module in your Drupal environment. 
 Configuration: Navigate to the module settings and input the obtained authentication keys. This enables the seamless introduction of CaptchEtat elements within forms and webforms, enhancing your website's security posture effectively. 
 
 Legal Considerations: 
 Before integrating this module, ensure compliance with legal requirements and obtain necessary authorization from relevant authorities. Adherence to regulatory standards is paramount to safeguarding user privacy and data integrity.

 Additional Links: 
 
 CaptchEtat API Documentation : Explore detailed documentation to understand the capabilities and integration methods of the CaptchEtat API. 
 Piste Gouv : Visit the official website to create an application and obtain authentication keys required for integrating CaptchEtat into your Drupal website. 
 
 Documentation and Support: 
 For detailed installation instructions, configuration guidelines, and troubleshooting assistance, refer to the comprehensive documentation provided with the module. Additionally, for any inquiries or support requests, feel free to reach out to the module maintainers or consult the Drupal community forums.

 Enhance your website's security and user experience today with the CaptchEtat integration module for Drupal.
